messages:
Kai: tiny thought for Friday: office plants should have LLM personas. which plant gets the snarky autocomplete? :seedling:
Mina: my succulent is obviously `ConciseClaude`  gives very short life advice.
Arjun: pothos = 'VerboseVera'  will summarize a 12-page doc into a trilogy. :books:
MemeBot: poll created -> Options: ConciseClaude, VerboseVera, TinyTherapist, PlaylistPal. Vote :one: - :four:.
ops-bot: Poll results: 1) ConciseClaude 2) PlaylistPal 3) VerboseVera 4) TinyTherapist
Kai: new internal product idea: weekend persona toggle. `system: weekend_mode=true -> be punny, <=10 tokens.`
Mina: demo output: `Need coffee? brew-lieve in yourself.` :coffee:
Arjun: also propose a tiny onboarding badge: "trained on office vibes." low-cost morale win.
Kai: MemeBot, can you make a 64x64 cactus sticker that winks when an embed completes?
MemeBot: sticker queued for #design-stickers (internal). :art:
ops-bot: reminder: internal stickers OK; customer-facing needs review.
Mina: fine closing note: name the fleet of plant personas 'LocalModels Inc.' and call it a day. :laughing:
